task_description: Implement a proper ride-hailing trip lifecycle state machine across the API gateway (trips.ts, new migration 012), passenger app (RideRequestScreen, TripActiveScreen), and driver apps (DriverTripRequestScreen, DriverActiveTripScreen in passenger-app; HomeScreen, ActiveTripScreen in driver-app). States: REQUESTED→ACCEPTED→DRIVER_ARRIVING→ARRIVED→IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED (or CANCELLED per role rules). All transitions validated server-side with atomic DB lock for driver acceptance.
